description: This file defines the RenderEngine class and related structures for the Android graphics rendering system, supporting GLES and Vulkan backends, with methods for resource management, drawing layers, and protected content handling.

classes.name: RenderEngine
classes.description: Abstract base class for rendering engine implementations, supporting resource management, layer drawing, and protected content features.

classes.name: RenderEngineCreationArgs
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for creating a RenderEngine instance.

classes.name: BindNativeBufferAsFramebuffer
classes.description: Helper class to bind a native window buffer as a framebuffer for rendering.

classes.name: SyncFeatures
classes.description: Singleton class providing information about synchronization features like native fence sync.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a RenderEngine with specified creation arguments.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs debug information about the RenderEngine.

methods.name: useNativeFenceSync
methods.description: Checks if native fence sync is supported.

methods.name: useWaitSync
methods.description: Checks if wait sync is supported.

methods.name: bindExternalTextureImage
methods.description: Binds an external image to a texture.

methods.name: bindExternalTextureBuffer
methods.description: Binds an external buffer to a texture, with legacy support.

methods.name: isProtected
methods.description: Checks if the engine is protected.

methods.name: supportsProtectedContent
methods.description: Checks if protected content is supported.

methods.name: useProtectedContext
methods.description: Enables or disables protected context usage.

methods.name: drawLayers
methods.description: Renders layers for a display with given settings.
